content:
**Enforced the chunk read-back boundary (#247, re-scoped per #863 D3): a bidirectional allowlist guard over every importer of the chunk readers, two pins, and a seven-row ledger for #874**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/memory/chunk-boundary.test.mjs: the importer set of collectChunkObservations must deepEqual an annotated allowlist [{file, retiredBy}] in both directions (a new importer fails; an allowlisted file that stops importing fails, so a retirement must update the list), matched over the whole source of brain/**/*.mjs and test/**/*.mjs so multi-line dynamic imports, aliases, re-exports and namespace or member access are seen; readChunkObservations has zero importers and zero definitions in any spelling; brain-audit and brain-check stay records-only; plainfiles share writes nothing under .memory/chunks (exact-tree pin on a real temp store). The only production diff is a header note in backends/engram.mjs pointing each chunk seam at its ledger row. Epic task 2.3 rewritten; the seven-row ledger restated on #874.

**Why**: the ticket said retire chunk materialization, but the ratified #863 D3 sequences 2.3 (read-back) before 3.2 (record-first, #874) before 2.4 (artifact retirement): engram.save is unsupportedOp, so share -> engram sync --export -> dualWriteRecords reading chunks is the only producer path today; cutting the export before #874 would stop captures reaching records entirely. The re-scope was posted on #247 with a veto line.

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/chunk-boundary.test.mjs, backends/plainfiles.share.test.mjs, backends/engram.mjs (comment), governance/run-check.test.mjs (comment); openspec/changes/issue-247-chunk-retirement/**; openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md.

**Learned**: the repo's source-guard idiom filters lines for a leading import and cannot see a three-line await import(); a guard must scan whole sources. A fresh cold review found seven import spellings the first guard missed and two false claims in prose (byte-identical, repo-wide); all fixed. A header note in the guarded file shifts every anchor below it: re-measure anchors after any edit. #874 inherits the ledger and must re-measure it before deleting.
